newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal govt details motorway privatisation plans.
newsitem.headline: Portugal govt details motorway privatisation plans.

text.p: The Portuguese government plans to privatise 160 km (100 miles) of motorway by the end of the year, a Planning Ministry spokesman said.
The government will grant two concessions, one for the west of the country and one for the north, to private firms who will then be responsible for building and operating the roads.
Only 29 km (18 miles) of the stretches earmarked for privatisation have so far been built.

The government will contribute up to 35 percent of investment costs, which are expected to total 49.8 billion escudos ($328 million), in cash grants and in the form of stretches of road already built.
The concession covering the west of Portugal will be granted in October and the one for the north in December.
